clerk_1.who: Hotel clerk (stick figure, white round head, long black stick legs)
clerk_1.pose: Standing, body front-on, head turned slightly right. One hand (viewer's right) raised with fingers cupped under chin in a thinking pose; other fist on hip (viewer's left). One eyebrow raised, flat suspicious eyes, mouth pursed to one side. Outfit: green waistcoat over white shirt with rolled sleeves, yellow tie, dark grey shoes, no hat.

clerk_2.who: Hotel clerk (same green waistcoat, yellow tie)
clerk_2.pose: Standing front-on, head slightly right. One hand (viewer's left) pinches one note of a fanned wad of green dollar bills held in the other hand (viewer's right). Greedy smirk, half-lidded eyes, tongue licking lip. No hat.

clerk_3.who: Hotel clerk (same green waistcoat, yellow tie)
clerk_3.pose: Standing front-on. One hand (viewer's right) raised open in a small wave, other arm hangs down open-palmed. Nervous wide smile, worried eyebrows, blue sweat drop on forehead. No hat.

lustig_1.who: Victor Lustig, con-man (navy double-breasted coat, cream scarf, orange pocket square, grey-black shoes)
lustig_1.pose: Standing, torso turned right. Arm on viewer's right extended with open palm up (presenting/offering); other arm hangs down at side. Confident smirk, one raised eyebrow, looking right. Black beret/flat cap (see outfit note). No props.
meaning: gesturing at something to the right

lustig_2.who: Victor Lustig (navy coat, cream scarf, orange pocket square)
lustig_2.pose: Standing, facing right. Holds a brown leather suitcase (brass corners) low in the hand on viewer's left; other hand on hip. Smug smirk, raised eyebrow. Black beret/flat cap.

lustig_3.who: Victor Lustig (navy coat, cream scarf, orange pocket square)
lustig_3.pose: Standing, narrow, front/slight right. Both arms behind back, hands hidden. Calm smug half-smile, eyebrow slightly raised. Black beret/flat cap. No props.

lustig_4.who: Victor Lustig (navy coat, cream scarf, orange pocket square)
lustig_4.pose: Standing front-on. Both arms out to the sides, palms up, white gloved hands open (shrug). Smirk, one eyebrow raised. Black beret/flat cap.

lustig_5.who: Victor Lustig (navy coat, cream scarf, orange pocket square)
lustig_5.pose: Standing, three-quarter right. Hand on viewer's right raised with index finger pointing up; other arm down. Open grin, bright eyes, eyebrows up. Black beret/flat cap.

lustig_6.who: Victor Lustig (navy coat, cream scarf, orange pocket square)
lustig_6.pose: Leaning/hunched forward, facing right. One finger pressed to lips (shush); other arm hangs down behind. Narrowed shifty eyes, brow low. Black beret/flat cap.

parisian_1.who: Parisian bystander (brown flat cap, brown herringbone tweed jacket, bright orange scarf, dark brown trousers)
parisian_1.pose: Standing front-on. Both hands pressed to cheeks, elbows out; mouth open in a gasp, wide worried eyes, brows raised.

parisian_2.who: Parisian bystander (same flat cap, tweed jacket, orange scarf)
parisian_2.pose: Standing front-on, both hands holding open a blank grey newspaper in front of chest; head above the paper. Angry frown, furrowed brows, mouth turned down. Newspaper has no text/headline.

parisian_3.who: Parisian bystander (same flat cap, tweed jacket, orange scarf)
parisian_3.pose: Standing front-on, arms crossed over chest. Scowl, one eyebrow lowered, mouth down.
